subject: Codex + Cursor local-CLI providers (agentic-cli) for the pluggable backend
description:
Add Codex CLI + Cursor CLI providers to lib/llm-backend.js as kind 'agentic-cli', mirroring the existing Claude provider (the template: resolveBin/isAvailable/isAuthed/buildInvocation/parseResult). Branch off orch/feature/pluggable-backend AFTER /18 merges (you collide with /18 on lib/llm-backend.js — that's why this is blocked on the /18 judge).
RESEARCH each CLI's non-interactive/headless invocation (WebSearch + inspect installed binaries if present):
- Codex: the `codex` CLI — find its non-interactive exec subcommand + output/stream + model + skip-confirmation flags (analogous to `claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --dangerously-skip-permissions`).
- Cursor: the `cursor-agent`/`cursor` CLI headless agent invocation.
Implement per provider: resolveBin (locate binary cross-platform incl. Windows .cmd/.exe), isAvailable (bin present), isAuthed (auth/config present), buildInvocation (return {bin,args,env} for a headless judge run mirroring the Claude flag semantics; budget carried through not as a flag), parseResult (parse CLI output to the SAME shape the Claude provider returns). registerProvider both into the registry. If a CLI is not installed, isAvailable=false is the correct behavior (provider still registered).
Tests: mock the bins; assert each provider's buildInvocation argv + isAvailable/isAuthed gating + parseResult shape; getActiveBackend selects each when overlay.config.backend.provider matches its id. node --check clean. SCOPE: only the two providers + registration + tests — do NOT touch the dashboard, the api backend, or drain routing (those resolve providers generically already). Blocked by /19 (the /18 merge).
